# The only skips a supported-matrix cell may report, one per line: test id | cells | reason.
# A skip not listed here fails the run: a test that did not run proves no row.
DeclineFunctionalTest.a Gradle older than 8_14 gets a named decline, runs every test, and captures nothing | */9.8.0/* | drives its own older Gradle, so the 8.14 cells run it once
TestJvmRangeFunctionalTest.test JVM on JDK 25 | */8.14/* | Gradle before 9.1 does not support Java 25
TestJvmRangeFunctionalTest.test JVM on the newest early-access JDK | */*/* | run by the early-access workflow, which fails if it skips there
